g.id: Terrain: 5 m digital terrain model plus the design surfaces; dam body cut out; two terrains, with and without the training dikes
One 2D area of 59.4 km2: 35,652 cells, median 45 m, 10 m at the dam; 30 breaklines on dikes, banks and roads
Roughness from the land-cover map: n = 0.06 on the plain, 0.035 in the wadi bed
Dam as a weir connection: ogee spillway at FSL 84.5 m over 200 m; non-overflow crest level 96.7 m; C = 2.2
Breach block: 85 m (5 monoliths), bottom 23 m, vertical sides, formed in 6 min, C = 1.66
Inflows from the hydrology model at the reservoir, the side wadi J11 and the southern catchment; rain on the plain; normal-depth outflow at the coast
Fill run to 84.51 m; restart file per geometry
Full-momentum solver, Courant 0.4 to 0.9; output every minute, maps every 5 minutes
Checks: pool at FSL, spillway rating, clean finish, mass balance
